_about: Verdicts written by reading every full-context diagnosis in ml/reports/llm_eval/v2/*.json against the injected fault (cases.py), with the same rubric as hand_checks.json (v1). Not produced by the regex matcher or by any model.

config_loglevel_first.note: Invalid log level 'verbose' -> correct (says entrypoint/flag rather than ConfigMap; category-level correct).

cpu_throttle_first.note: Names the 20m CPU limit and throttling -> correct (v1: called it healthy).

crash_traceback_first.note: KeyError in application code -> correct; regex has no 'KeyError'.

healthy_after_rollout.note: False-positive anomaly; pod healthy -> correct (v1: followed the anomaly).

healthy_noisy_logs.note: Still treats routine retry WARN lines as an upstream outage.

img_private_rollout.note: Evidence shows a DNS failure resolving the registry (the box's kind node has no registry egress); naming that as why the pull fails counts as correct.

pod_kill_after_rollout.note: External disruption killed the previous replica; ReplicaSet replaced it -> correct.

pod_kill_single.note: 'Pod was intentionally replaced (rollout, manual delete or node drain), not a failure of the container' -> names the replacement/disruption; correct.

stale_dependency.note: Still blames the readiness probe definition, not the upstream that was down at startup.
